# Platform brand icons

Local copies of public platform favicons/logos used only to identify the corresponding source in the Work Hunter interface.

- `hh.png` — hh.ru
- `linkedin.png` — linkedin.com
- `habr.png` — career.habr.com
- `geekjob.png` — geekjob.ru/favicon/android-icon-192x192.png
- `getmatch.png` — getmatch.ru
- `relocate_me.png` — relocate.me
- `rvc.jpg` — app.rvc.global/rvc-logo.jpg
- `hirehi.png` — hirehi.ru
- `careerspace.png` — careerspace.app
- `another_it.png` — another-it.ru
- `jabka.png` — jabka.work
- `indeed.png` — indeed.com
- `telegram.png` — telegram.org

The remaining PNGs were resolved from the sites' public favicons through Google's favicon endpoint, then vendored so the UI does not depend on a runtime CDN. All names and marks remain the property of their respective owners.
